info.title: OpenVPN Docker Management API
info.description: Authenticated REST API for frontend management of clients, runtime state, diagnostics, and declarative configuration. Except for health and documentation, send the API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Process health, build metadata, and instance diagnostics.

tags.name: Clients
tags.description: Client credentials, profiles, IPv4 intent, and active sessions.

tags.name: Runtime
tags.description: OpenVPN daemon status and structured event history.

get.description: Unauthenticated liveness check. It does not report OpenVPN or storage health.
Returns the state summary plus an issues array when diagnostic issues exist.

get.summary: List active, revoked, and deleted clients

delete.description: Requires an empty body. The immutable client UUID tombstone remains in authoritative state.

get.description: The response contains a private key and must be handled as a credential.

put.description: Use auto or dynamic without address. Use static with an address from the configured static region.

delete.summary: Release a revoked client's retained IPv4
delete.description: Requires an empty body and is valid only for a revoked client with a retained assignment.

post.description: Requires an empty body. A client with no active session returns 200 with was_connected=false.

get.summary: Read OpenVPN runtime status and sessions
Read desired configuration and CAS digest

put.description: Send the previous desired digest as a quoted If-Match value and the complete normalized configuration as the body.

post.summary: Apply the current desired configuration online
post.description: Use desired_digest from GET/PUT desired and current_revision from GET plan. The API remains available while OpenVPN and the broker restart.

bearerAuth.description: API key created locally with `ovpn api key create`.
